source.snippet: Sometimes an email sent to me from a known source goes to delete folder. If I recover it from deleted folder in time and respond to that email, my reply now goes to delete folder as well. There is no filter causing this.

problem_statement: Gmail users experience unexplained automatic deletion of legitimate emails and replies with no identifiable filter rule, leaving them unable to diagnose or fix the issue through standard Gmail tooling.
target_segment: Business professionals and power users relying on Gmail for critical communications
notes: Signals demand for a Gmail audit/diagnostic tool that surfaces hidden or conflicting rules, label behaviors, and routing anomalies beyond what Gmail's native UI exposes. Could be a Chrome extension or OAuth-based web app.
